senses.gloss: अर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) Excellent.
अर्य (II) m. 1. A master; 2. a Vaiśya.
अर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) Excellent.
अर्या f. 1. A mistress; 2. a woman of the Vaiśya tribe.
आर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) Noble, high respectable, स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानाम् Ram.

आर्य (II) m. 1. Name of the Hindu and the Iranian people as distinguished from अनार्य, दस्यु, दास (the distinction is very clearly seen in the Vedic literature); 2. name of the first three castes as opposed to Śūdra; 3. a master; 4. a preceptor; 5. a friend; 6. a father-in-law (as in आर्यपुत्र); 7. a man who is faithful to the religion and customary law of his country (कर्तव्यमाचरन् कार्यमकर्तव्यमनाचरन् । तिष्ठति प्रकृताचारे स वा आर्य इति स्मृतः); 8. a man of high birth; 9. a man of noble character; 10. a respectable man; 11. an honorific designation (in theatrical language). The following lines contain rules as to the use of this designation- (1) (वाच्यः) विप्र आर्येति चेतरैः, (2) वाच्यौ नटीसूत्रधारावार्यनाम्ना परस्परम्, (3) वयस्येत्युत्तमैर्वाच्यो मध्यैरार्येति चाग्रजः, (4) वक्तव्योऽमात्य आर्येति चेतरैः.
आर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) Noble, high respectable, स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानाम् Ram.
आर्या f. 1. A name of Pārvatī; 2. a mother-in-law; 3. a respectable lady; 4. a kind of metre. (See App. I.)
अर्य-वर्य m. a Vaiśya of rank. (The word has three fem. forms अर्या, अर्यी, अर्याणी qq.vv.)
अर्यमन् m. 1. The sun; 2. a name of the arka plant; 3. the head of the pitṛs, पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि Bg.x.29.
अर्याणी f. The same as अर्या q.v.
अर्यी f. The wife of a Vaiśya.

आर्य-आवर्त m. name of the land extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bound on the north and south by the Himālaya and the Vindhya respectively; आसमुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादासमुद्राच्च पश्चिमात् । तयोरेवान्तरं गिर्योः (i.e. हिमवद्विन्ध्ययोः) आर्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः M.ii.22.
आर्य-गृह्य a. 1. easily accessible to an honourable man, तमार्यगृह्यं निगृहीतधेनुः R.ii.33; 2. deserving honour, respectable.
आर्य-देश m. a region inhabited by Āryas.

आर्य-पुत्र m. 1. son of an honourable man; 2. the son of a spiritual preceptor; 3. an honourific designation of the son of an elder brother of a husband by his wife, or of a prince by his general; 4. son of the father-in-law, i.e. husband (in theatrical language). (In this sense, the word occurs in almost every play in speeches assigned to female characters.)
आर्य-प्राय a. 1. inhabited by the Āryas; 2. abounding with respectable persons.
आर्य-मार्ग m. the way of the honourable.
आर्य-मिश्र (I) a. distinguished, respectable.
आर्य-मिश्र (II) m. a gentleman, a man of consequence, a respectable man, a man of honour, एवमार्यमिश्रान् प्रणिपत्य विज्ञापयामि Pr.Ch.i.
आर्य-वृत्त n. the behaviour of a nobleman.
आर्य-सत्य n. a noble or sublime truth.
आर्य-हृद्य a. beloved by the noble.
आर्यक m. The same as आर्य q.v. (The feminine form of this word is either आर्यका or आर्यिका).
आर्या-गीति f. See App. I.
